label: جديد

angle.hook: a racing game where ramming your rivals is how you progress ('aggression equals progression', Steam page), now with a Steam page
angle.why_now: Directrix Productions opened the Project Stampede Steam page with its alpha trailer (first report Game*Spark 14 Nov 2026 05:18Z; devlog 'Wishlist Project Stampede on Steam + The Road Ahead' on itch.io 15 Nov 02:52Z). The game itself has been public since early 2026 as a downloadable alpha on itch.io, so the news is the Steam page, not an announcement; no Arabic outlet has carried it
angle.what_it_means_here: players in the region who miss MotorStorm-era off-road arcade racers get a new PC game to wishlist on Steam; no date or price yet
angle.payoff: ten vehicle classes from dirt bikes to monster trucks, and the developer's stated aim: the arcade racers of the sixth and seventh console generations

story_type_items.TRAILER OR FIRST LOOK: what the footage shows that is new: the alpha 0.1.6 build (dirt bikes, quads, buggies, rally cars, monster trucks, big trucks, takedowns, desert and canyon tracks); the actual Steam trailer 'Project Stampede Alpha 0.1.6 Trailer', credited «المصدر: دايركتريكس (Directrix)» (short form: the full name ran out of the safe zone at render 1) on every shot from frame 0

sensitive: none: vehicle takedowns and crashes only, no people hurt on screen, no weapons
decision_log: 0 cover: red off-road car racing at the camera at sunset, 28.62 to 29.22 (fo 0.45 in v4: v3's 0.33 left the red car at the window's edge; the white car's rear text stays outside the window); the dirt-bike rider (20.22) was the first choice but his helmet sits in the headline band, so he moved to the bike line; 28.42 to 28.6 (a pink car with livery text) and 29.25 (POLICE text) avoided

1 car leaping the canyon 17.55 (0.85; the white flash at 17.0 to 17.5 avoided), 2 quads 10.0 (0.9; text the prerender read at 10.95 avoided), 3 buggy 7.3 (0.9; white frame at 7.0 and text read at 8.25 avoided; the festival at 8.4 to 9.4 dropped for sign text in the window): headline window, 3.25 s

4 to 9 trucks on the road 32.55 (0.95; the dark tunnel before 32.5 avoided), rally car past the chevrons 35.0 (0.6; white at 35.75 avoided), blue car in green smoke 25.7 (0.5; text at 25.21 to 25.66 and 26.25 to 27.37 avoided), jump 33.5 and canyon 34.25, sunset 30.8 (after the white at 30.5) under «فُتحت صفحة Project Stampede على Steam» (illustration: racing from the Steam trailer); v5 cuts the rally shot to 0.33 s

10 to 13 dirt-bike rider 20.22 (0.93; text read at 21.17 avoided; his head sits high in the frame and the line band is low, nothing over his face), dirt bike 13.75 (2.0; the banner frame at 13.45 to 13.7 avoided), monster truck head-on 24.05 (0.47), big truck 37.25 (0.5; the teal car with a number at 37.0 to 37.2 avoided) under «اللعبة سباق بدراجات ترابية وشاحنات عملاقة»: each shot shows the vehicle the line names

14 card «فئات المركبات 10» over the trailer (ground_footage start 11.35: numgfx plays the ground from start + the card's Reel time, about 10.0 to 10.65 s, so it shows server 21.35 to 25.0 s, the sky, track and monster-truck stretch, blurred and dimmed; v2's ground (32.21 + the card time = about 42.5 s) showed the trailer's burnt-in 'AGGRESSION IS PROGRESSION, BABY' subtitle); the count lives only on the card

15 to 18 jump against the sky 22.0, bike into the tunnel 23.0, a buggy's headlights in the night canyon 31.45 (v4: replaces the big truck at 38.15, whose crop showed a readable sponsor banner, 'BEERBOT', in v3), a buggy tumbling after a takedown 19.15 (fo 0.45; the pink flash at 19.0 avoided) under «تحيي سباقات الأركيد القديمة حسب مطورها»: air and takedowns are the arcade beats; the last 2 s are the tumbling buggy (a picture, no card)

sound: one stretch of the trailer's own sound from 7.2 s (server file; the voice line ends at 6.88 s there) (a loud synth score from 3 s to 43 s); the voiceover lines are at 4.86 to 6.54 s and 40.0 to 41.86 s (faster-whisper without VAD), outside the stretch (7.0 to about 27); the audio split keeps the music stem and each shot's own effects

v2: every start moved 0.34 s earlier. The server's fetch (trailer.fetch, ffmpeg -ss 0 on the HLS) starts the video stream at 3.02 s and the audio at 0.34 s, so its seek lands 0.35 s later than the session's whole-file copy (measured frame-exact at 20.5 and 33.0 s); v1 therefore showed the white flashes at 35.75 and 9.75 and the festival sign at 8.4. Times in this log are the session copy's; the job's starts are the server file's (session time minus 0.34)

v5 (director FAIL on v4, 7f6429b): rally-car shot cut to 0.33 s (server 34.66 to 34.99; the fade starts at 35.01 and the white peaks 35.13 to 35.16, per-frame luma of the server-style copy); every other shot scanned per frame: no frame over luma 210 except a spark highlight at 17.98 (206) and the bright sky at 21.66 (200), both picture, not flashes. Line 1 now says the Steam page opened (the game has had itch.io alphas since early 2026), line 2 names the game («اللعبة سباق…»), line 3 «تحيي…» follows that subject; chip جديد; job renamed project-stampede-steam-alpha-v5 for distinct sidecars; v5 also trims the two dark frames at the start of the trucks shot (server 32.21 to 32.23) and the dark last frames of the sunset and canyon shots, measured per frame

reel_check.4 subject named before pronoun, no line: yes: line 1 names the game, line 2 opens on «اللعبة», line 3's verb follows that subject; no line opens on و

reel_check.5 caption: yes: first five words carry لعبة السباقات Project Stampede and the news word

reel_check.5 urgency: yes: chip جديد (the Steam page is new; the game has been public on itch.io since early 2026, so not نظرة أولى); «ولم يُعلن موعد صدورها بعد» in the caption
reel_check.6 sound: yes: the trailer's own sound, one stretch from 7.2 s (server file), audio split
reel_check.6 no narration under lines: yes: whisper (no VAD) hears speech only at 4.86 to 6.54 and 40.0 to 41.86 s, both outside the stretch
